name: Markiplier
bio: Mark Edward Fischbach, known as Markiplier, is one of YouTube's most beloved creators. Known for his horror game playthroughs, wild comedic energy, and genuine love for his community.

name: Technoblade
bio: Technoblade was a Minecraft legend whose wit, skill and humour captured millions. He passed away in 2022, but his words — and his community — live on. Technoblade never dies.

name: Jacksepticeye
bio: Seán McLoughlin, known as Jacksepticeye, built one of YouTube's most positive and energetic communities. Known for his loud intros, genuine heart, and relentless positivity.

name: MrBeast
bio: Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, is the most subscribed individual creator on YouTube. Famous for jaw-dropping philanthropy, insane challenges, and genuinely just wanting to make people happy.

name: VanossGaming
bio: Evan Fong, known as VanossGaming, is the king of chaotic fun. With the Banana Bus Squad, he turned gaming into pure unscripted comedy gold.

name: PewDiePie
bio: Felix Kjellberg is the most subscribed individual creator in YouTube history. From gaming chaos to meme reviews, PewDiePie shaped an entire generation of internet culture.

name: Dream
bio: Dream is the Minecraft content creator who turned a simple game into a global phenomenon with his Manhunt series and the Dream SMP — a server that became a world.

name: TommyInnit
bio: Tom Simons, known as TommyInnit, became one of the fastest-growing creators in history while still a teenager. Loud, chaotic, and genuinely kind underneath it all.

name: ElRubius
bio: Rubén Doblas Gundersen, known as ElRubius, is Spain's most beloved YouTuber. Half Spanish, half Norwegian, he built a global community through chaotic gaming and pure personality.

name: CarryMinati
bio: Ajey Nagar, known as CarryMinati, is India's most subscribed YouTuber. Starting at age 10, he built an empire through roasting, music, and raw unfiltered energy.

name: BB Ki Vines
bio: Bhuvan Bam, known as BB Ki Vines, was the first Indian solo creator to hit 10 million subscribers. A musician, actor, and comedian who plays every character himself.

name: Mariana Nolasco
bio: Mariana Nolasco is one of Brazil's most beloved content creators — known for her authenticity, energy, and creating a community where everyone feels welcome.

name: xQc
bio: Félix Lengyel, known as xQc, is one of the most-watched streamers on the planet. Chaotic, unfiltered, and always entertaining.

name: Valkyrae
bio: Rachell Hofstetter, known as Valkyrae, went from GameStop employee to Content Creator of the Year. Co-owner of 100 Thieves and one of the most inspiring stories in gaming.

name: Pokimane
bio: Imane Anys, known as Pokimane, is one of the most influential streamers on the internet. Known for her authenticity, kindness, and being a role model for a generation of female creators.

name: Ludwig
bio: Ludwig Ahgren holds the record for the longest subathon in Twitch history — 31 days. He then left Twitch for YouTube in one of the biggest moves in streaming history.

name: Ninja
bio: Tyler Blevins, known as Ninja, brought gaming to mainstream culture. He streamed Fortnite with Drake and performed at the Super Bowl. Currently fighting cancer with the same intensity he brings to every game.

name: Shroud
bio: Michael Grzesiek, known as Shroud, is widely considered the greatest FPS player to ever stream. A former CS:GO pro who traded trophies for a camera and never looked back.

name: Sykkuno
bio: Sykkuno is the most wholesome streamer on the internet. A former accountant who became one of the most-loved creators in gaming — proof that calm and genuine wins.

name: IShowSpeed
bio: Darren Watkins Jr., known as IShowSpeed, is pure unfiltered energy. From 0 to global phenomenon in record time — a movement as much as a creator.

name: LilyPichu
bio: LilyPichu is a musician, artist, and streamer who proves that softness is a superpower. A founding member of OfflineTV whose creativity and heart have touched millions.

name: Mizkif
bio: Matthew Rinaudo, known as Mizkif, is chaos personified. Co-founder of OTK and one of the most entertaining personalities in streaming — just a guy from Texas who made it work.

name: APJ Abdul Kalam
bio: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam was India's 11th President, a pioneering aerospace scientist, and the most beloved teacher a nation ever had. Known as the Missile Man of India.

name: Kobe Bryant
bio: Kobe Bryant — the Black Mamba — was a five-time NBA champion and one of the greatest competitors who ever lived. He passed in 2020, but the Mamba Mentality lives on.

name: Malala Yousafzai
bio: Malala Yousafzai is the youngest Nobel Peace Prize laureate in history. Shot by the Taliban at 15 for demanding education for girls, she survived and became one of the most powerful voices on earth.

name: DanTDM
bio: Daniel Middleton, known as DanTDM, is one of the most beloved family-friendly creators on YouTube. He sold out arenas worldwide and holds a Guinness World Record — all while keeping things clean and kind.

name: penguinz0
bio: Charles White Jr., known as penguinz0 or MoistCr1TiKaL, is the internet's most deadpan philanthropist. He has raised millions for charity while reviewing bad games with a completely straight face.

name: MKBHD
bio: Marques Brownlee, known as MKBHD, is the most respected tech reviewer on YouTube. Starting at 15 in his bedroom, he built a legacy of quality that made him the gold standard of tech content.

name: Ibai
bio: Ibai Llanos is Spain's biggest streamer and one of the most creative minds in the space. From caster to KOI co-owner to boxing promoter — he just keeps saying why not.

name: Kurzgesagt
bio: Kurzgesagt is a Munich-based animation studio making the most beautiful science and philosophy videos on YouTube. Their mission: make humanity a little wiser, one video at a time.
